title: Conversational Q&A Chains
summary: This module provides chains for building conversational question-answering systems. It handles chat history to rephrase user questions, retrieves relevant documents, and synthesizes answers using language models.

nodes.label: User Query
nodes.title: User Input
nodes.description: The initial question or turn from the user in a conversation.

nodes.label: Chat History
nodes.title: Conversation Context
nodes.description: A record of previous messages in the conversation, used to maintain context.

nodes.label: Contextualize Question
nodes.title: Rephrase Question for Retrieval
nodes.description: Transforms the user's current question, using chat history, into a standalone query suitable for document retrieval. Implemented by `create_history_aware_retriever` or internal logic of `ConversationalRetrievalChain`.

nodes.label: LLM for Rephrasing
nodes.title: Language Model for Query Generation
nodes.description: A Large Language Model (LLM) used to generate a clear, standalone search query from the user's input and chat history.

nodes.label: Retrieve Documents
nodes.title: Fetch Relevant Information
nodes.description: Retrieves relevant documents or text chunks from a knowledge base based on the contextualized question. Uses a `BaseRetriever` or directly queries a `VectorStore`.

nodes.label: Vector Database
nodes.title: Document Storage & Search
nodes.description: An external vector database storing embeddings of documents, enabling semantic search for relevant information.

nodes.label: Combine Documents
nodes.title: Prepare Context for LLM
nodes.description: Processes and formats the retrieved documents along with the question, preparing them as input for the answer generation LLM. Often uses a `StuffDocumentsChain`.

nodes.label: LLM for Answering
nodes.title: Language Model for Response Generation
nodes.description: A Large Language Model (LLM) that generates the final answer based on the user's question and the combined retrieved context.

nodes.label: Conversational Q&A Chain
nodes.title: Orchestrate Conversational Q&A
nodes.description: The core chain (`ConversationalRetrievalChain` or `ChatVectorDBChain`) that orchestrates the entire process: contextualizing the question, retrieving documents, and generating a final answer.

nodes.label: Final Answer
nodes.title: System Response
nodes.description: The final, human-readable answer generated by the system, incorporating retrieved information and conversational context.

groups.label: Input Handling
groups.title: Manage User Input and History
groups.description: Components responsible for receiving user queries and managing the ongoing conversation history.

groups.label: Query Processing
groups.title: Transform User Query
groups.description: Processes the raw user query and chat history to create a clear, standalone question for effective retrieval.

groups.label: Information Retrieval
groups.title: Fetch Relevant Data
groups.description: Locates and retrieves pertinent documents or data from a knowledge base based on the processed query.

groups.label: Response Synthesis
groups.title: Generate Final Answer
groups.description: Combines retrieved information with the original question to formulate a coherent and contextualized conversational response.

groups.label: Output
groups.title: Deliver Final Response
groups.description: The final stage where the generated answer is presented to the user.
